name: double_mid_band_renders_exponent
description: A double in the (2^53, 2^63) band (5e18) MUST render in exponent notation, not plain decimal. This is the band that exposes the boundary: 5e18 is below the int64 edge, so a 2^63 plain threshold would emit the bare-integer token 5000000000000000000, which is > 2^53-1 and would be rejected by a binary64-integer host (JavaScript) decoding in its default policy, an encoder emitting a token it cannot read back. The double plain/exponent boundary is 2^53, so 5e18 renders 5e+18 and decodes as a double everywhere. SPEC 2.3.1.
